groups.name: Research directions
groups.blurb: J-lens and Ouro, organized into five research branches. Initial coverage focuses on readout methods and model architecture.

groups.name: Source types
groups.blurb: Find papers, code, evaluations, explanations and discussions. A source's format does not establish the strength of its evidence.

topics.name: J-lens
topics.definition: Methods, results and limitations of J-lens. Follow source links to distinguish reported findings from interpretations.

topics.name: Ouro / looped LM
topics.definition: The first case: applying J-lens to Ouro. Track loop steps, target exits and evaluation conditions; published code alone does not establish a reproduction.

topics.name: Readout methods
topics.definition: What do J-lens, R-lens and J-lens++ read out, and how should their improvements be compared? Initial coverage priority.

topics.name: Model architecture
topics.definition: Which observations carry over to looped and recurrent language models? Initial coverage focuses on Ouro and the role of target exits.

topics.name: Causal evidence
topics.definition: Does information that can be read out also play a causal role in the model's computation? Coverage is being built; decodability alone does not answer this question.

topics.name: Monitoring
topics.definition: Can readouts provide useful signals before an answer, beyond suitable baselines? Coverage is being built; timing and evaluation conditions matter.

topics.name: Meaning of J-space
topics.definition: How do vocabulary, token frequency, vector norms and descriptions affect J-space conclusions? Coverage is being built.

topics.name: Papers & reports
topics.definition: Research papers and technical reports within the current J-lens and Ouro scope. Check the version, methods and stated limitations.

topics.name: Code & repositories
topics.definition: Source code and research tools. Code availability, a runnable environment and a reproduced result are separate states.

topics.name: Evaluations & replications
topics.definition: Evaluations and replication reports. Compare estimators, datasets, model checkpoints and target exits before comparing scores.

topics.name: Guides & explanations
topics.definition: Short explanations and practical checks that help readers enter the research direction and understand what a result can establish.

topics.name: Discussion & critiques
topics.definition: Research discussions, critiques and competing explanations. A public discussion is a source to inspect, rather than independent confirmation of its claims.
